title: Manner in which declaration shall be made

checks.requirement: Declaration must be legible and prominent
MRP and net quantity numerals must conspicuously contrast with background
Hand-written or hand-script declaration must be clear, unambiguous and legible
Declaration must not require reading through liquid commodity
Outside wrapper/container must also carry required declarations unless transparent and inner declarations are easily readable
Required declaration particulars must be in Hindi (Devanagari) or English; additional languages allowed
